game.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided
game.blurb: Action RPG from Eidos Montreal, released 2016-08-22. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Adam Jensen's missions, from Dubai to the GARM facility and beyond. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Playthrough Challenges
chapters.summary: Finishing a whole run without killing anyone or without triggering a single alarm.

chapters.title: Secrets, Side Jobs and eBooks
chapters.summary: The keypad code, the Gold Penguin, Koller's favours, the cucumbers and every unique eBook.

chapters.title: Augmentations, Combat and Hacking
chapters.summary: Upgrading weapons and the Aug Tree, experimental augs, stealth, drones and hacking challenges.

chapters.title: Breach Mode
chapters.summary: The separate Breach mode: server networks, Darknet files, deliveries and challenges.

chapters.title: System Rift (story)
chapters.summary: The System Rift Jensen Story, its server chamber and its no-kill run.

chapters.title: A Criminal Past (story)
chapters.summary: A Criminal Past, set in a prison: Cell Block B, inmates, trades and a no-kill run.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 337000)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (deusex.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://deusex.fandom.com/wiki/Deus_Ex:_Mankind_Divided
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Deus Ex: Mankind Divided" or "Deus Ex Mankind Divided", and a StrategyWiki search for it came back empty. deusex.fandom.com answers the API, with about 137 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 30 of 81 Steam achievements are hidden. The descriptions name three add-on parts: Breach (a separate mode), "the System Rift Jensen Story" and "A Criminal Past"; the data does not say which are paid DLC. 6 hidden ones listed between the first Breach block and the System Rift achievements ("Extract the Data…" to "Knock Knock") were put in System Rift by schema position, and so was the visible "Too Hot to Handle" (server chamber), which sits right before "Clean Sweep"; this needs checking, since they could belong to Breach. 5 hidden ones inside the A Criminal Past block were put there by schema position. The other 19 hidden ones sit in the main story; "I Never Asked For This" (1.7 percent), "Laputan Machine" (6.9) and "Ballsy" (4.5) have low unlock rates and may be difficulty or optional goals. Story-flavoured visible ones (Singh, Talos Rucker debate, GARM ice drill, Dubai tutorials) were put in the main story by their descriptions.
